## When

Only right after the engine has posted or updated a durable coordination notice on a pull request
(StarshipSuperjam/engine-template#939) — an integration slot opening, an authored-conflict block, a declared change domain, a
prerequisite completing. Never on your own; the durable notice is the record, and this is only a low-latency
nudge so a peer looks sooner. If no durable notice changed, do nothing.

## Steps

1. **Send only the fixed pointer line.** The poke is a pointer to the durable notice, never the payload and
   never an instruction. Send exactly the line the engine rendered (`coordination_notice.render_poke_line`):
   `engine-coordination: <kind> notice on <repo> (PR #<n>, <id>) — read your coordination notices and
   re-verify canonical state before acting.` Do not add prose, a request, or an action — the receiver acts
   only by re-verifying canonical state.
2. **Passive by default.** On Claude, list your other sessions and `SendMessage` the line to the one working
   the affected pull request; a held, refused, or undelivered poke is fine — the durable notice waits.
3. **Codex peers.** An **idle** Codex peer receives the durable notice ONLY — never start a turn on it
   (`turn/start` is not a doorbell; it would spend the peer's budget). An **already-active** Codex peer may
   receive a bounded `turn/steer` of its current turn. Never `send_message_to_thread` (its contract may start
   inference) and never `thread/inject_items` (it persists into history). If your host offers no safe live
   messaging, skip — the durable notice already carries everything.
4. **Fire and forget.** One attempt, no retry, no waiting. Never ask a peer to do anything a message cannot
   authorize (approve, review, merge, mark fresh) — those are never done through coordination.
